title: Jubilant Smoky Egyptian Flatbread
description: A salty, aerated Egyptian flatbread perfect for a lazy Sunday, featuring a long-fermentation dough and lacto-vegetarian friendly ingredients, cooked to perfection on a binchotan grill.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, bicarbonate of soda, salt, sugar, and yeast.
Gradually add warm water and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it ferment in a warm place for 24 hours.
Preheat the binchotan grill to medium high heat.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Brush the dough with olive oil and yogurt.
Place the flatbreads on the preheated grill and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and puffed.
Remove the flatbreads from the grill and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
